note: Triennial election of the 23 district electoral divisions of Ballymena rural district, one member each (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). Polling in the contested divisions took place on Thursday 5 June 1924 and the results were declared on 6 June. The News-Letter's results paragraph covers the four contests only; one division (Glenbuck) had no nomination and three others that had two nominations in May produced no recorded poll and are omitted. Kidd, the sitting member, 222; Lagan, 206; majority 16. The nomination list also names Edward T. M'Graw for this division; he does not appear in the poll.
